checked_claims.note: Pass-2 reconstruction. h^0(L)=4 ⇒ h^0(M)=3 by CLM-0066-1; Clifford equality with deg M=4∉{0,10} forces C hyperelliptic and M≅(g^1_2)^⊗2. Castelnuovo–Severi gives g≤3 unless the deg-2 and deg-4 maps to P^1 share a common factor; that factor has degree dividing 2 and ≥2, hence equals h, so γ=q∘h. Pushforward: h_*O=O⊕O(-7); for every deg-2 q one has deg q_*O(-7)=-8 and h^0(q_*O(-7)⊗O(3))=h^0(O(-1))=0, forcing q_*O(-7)=O(-4)^2 and E=O(1)⊕O(4)^2. Then Sym^2E(-6)=O(-4)⊕O(-1)^2⊕O(2)^3 has h^0=9. Whatever line-bundle target the CE multiplication map uses after the −6 twist, it has degree 12>2g−2, so h^1=0 and h^0=7; with F=ker one gets h^0(F(-6))≥2, while balanced F(-6)=O(-2)⊕O(-1) has h^0=0. Contradiction. Normalization unused for this exclusion; SRC-0004/Lemma 10.6 pin F as the degree-(g+3)=9 bundle with balanced type (4,5), so the F-versus-F^vee orientation is consistent.

Under the stated weak normalization, CLM-0066-2 gives h^0(L)∈{3,4}; CLM-0086-1 removes 4, so h^0(L_b)=3 on every geometric fibre and B_4=∅. B reduced with constant h^0=3 is exactly Grauert’s setting, so p_*L is locally free of rank 3 with base change; CLM-0066-5/FND-0107 identify the closed Abel–Jacobi incidence with P((p_*L)^vee), a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle. No stack widening, no cohomological/Tate/Gysin claim, and RED-0001 is explicitly disclaimed.

finding_candidates.caveat: Does not by itself identify the splitting type as (2,7); only the inequality excluding (4,5) and (3,6). Remains a candidate until independently corroborated.

scope.generality: any smooth genus-6 curve; applies to every degree-12 target of the twisted CE multiplication map

finding_candidates.statement: On any smooth genus-6 curve, every line bundle of degree 12 has h^1=0 and h^0=7, because ω⊗L^{-1} has degree −2<0. Consequently the CE section-count obstruction on a composed hyperelliptic tetragonal cover—h^0(Sym^2E(−6))=9 and h^0(F(−6))≥2 for E=O(1)⊕O(4)^2—is insensitive to replacing the twisted scroll target O_{P(E^vee)}(2)|_C⊗γ^*O(−6) by ω_{C/P^1}^⊗2⊗γ^*O(−6) or by A^6, and needs no weak CE relative-canonical normalization.
finding_candidates.why_reusable: Removes a recurring Pic^0/normalization objection to the model-free half of the hyperelliptic CE incompatibility, so later artifacts may invoke h^0(F(−6))≥2 on composed covers without carrying the scroll=canonical identification into the exclusion step.

finding_candidates.caveat: Standard, but easy to omit in compressed writeups; recorded because ATT-0086 compresses it to one sentence. Remains a candidate until independently corroborated.

scope.generality: smooth curves of genus 6 with a g^1_2 and a degree-4 map to P^1

finding_candidates.statement: For a smooth genus-6 curve admitting maps h:C→P^1 of degree 2 and γ:C→P^1 of degree 4, Castelnuovo–Severi non-independence alone does not name the factorization; one must add that any common intermediate factor φ:C→C' has deg(φ) dividing 2 and at least 2, hence φ=h (up to automorphism of the target) and γ=q∘h with deg q=2.
finding_candidates.why_reusable: Makes the compressed Castelnuovo–Severi step in hyperelliptic-tetragonal arguments audit-safe without reopening the numerical bound g≤3.

strongest_attack:
Binding checked: TASK packet_sha256 0afc96f344542e5401e13179da3087c1c8ad078537111240028544967a642d70, packet_binding_sha256 76cc8a6d6ca02a2a9b1d7857fa11d7278f9732fa823f7be67dd51a354645bcc7, packet_id C66-001-v4, campaign_revision 4, context_revision 2, subproblem C66-COMP-COMP, and all twelve target keys match the attempt; the judged statement is the attempt theorem_statement (lemma), not RED-0001.

STRONGEST ATTACK (Pass 2) — Pic^0 / target-sheaf ambiguity in the CE multiplication map. Without the weak normalization, O_{P(E^vee)}(2)|_C and ω_{C/P^1}^⊗2 may differ by a degree-0 line bundle on C not pulled back from P^1, so the writeup’s identification of the twisted target with H^0(C,A^6) (A=h^*O(1)) is not a priori justified, and a wrong target could in principle change h^0 and collapse the 9−7≥2 lower bound. Attack fails: after the −6 twist every candidate target has degree 12>2g−2=10, hence h^1=0 and h^0=7 for every degree-12 line bundle on a genus-6 curve; with F defined as the sheaf kernel one still gets h^0(F(-6))≥2, while balanced F(-6)=O(-2)⊕O(-1) has h^0=0.

RUNNER-UP — F versus F^vee sign flip. Literature sometimes writes the middle term of the degree-4 resolution with F^vee, which would replace balanced O(4)⊕O(5) by O(−4)⊕O(−5) and erase the section-count contrast. Attack fails: SRC-0004 takes F of rank 2 and degree g+3=9 with W=O(2)⊗γ^*F^vee, and χ(Sym^2E)−χ(γ_*R) forces deg(ker)=+9, matching O(4)⊕O(5) and the hyperelliptic comparison type (2,7).

OTHER ATTACKS DEFEATED. (a) Castelnuovo–Severi supplies only non-independence; the missing line (common factor degree divides 2 and ≥2 ⇒ equals h) holds. (b) q_*O(−7)=O(−4)^2 is forced for every deg-2 q by degree −8 plus vanishing after ⊗O(3), so the model z=x^2 is cosmetic. (c) Grauert nonreduced failure is blocked by the reduced-base hypothesis (FND-0131). (d) No Brauer obstruction to Zariski-local triviality of P of a locally free rank-3 sheaf. (e) Stack/coarse, integral/rational coefficients, BM-versus-ordinary degree, Poincaré/Tate twists, Gysin/Künneth, SS differentials, Aut invariants/coinvariants, semisimplification, predicted motives, pure-Tate→tautological upgrades, and omitted stable pairs do not arise: the lemma makes no cohomological claim. Residual scope only: discharges the balanced B_4/P^3 piece for C66-COMP-COMP; does not settle image components in M_{6,6} or RED-0001.
theorem_statement: Let B be a reduced locally Noetherian scheme over a characteristic-zero field carrying a smooth genus-six degree-four Casnati–Ekedahl family whose relations bundle is fibrewise balanced, F_b ≅ O(4) ⊕ O(5), and which satisfies the weak CE relative-canonical normalization used in ATT-0066. For the canonical quotient W_5 put L=W_5⊗ω^{-1}. Then h^0(C_b,L_b)=3 for every geometric b in B; equivalently, the jump stratum B_4={b:h^0(L_b)=4} is empty. Consequently the closed degree-six Abel–Jacobi incidence Hilb^6(C/B)×_{Pic^6(C/B)}B is a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle over B. Thus a proposed balanced component decomposition containing a nonempty B_4/P^3 piece is false.
